title: TC002-Responsive Navigation Menu Behavior
description: Verify desktop and mobile navigation menus including hamburger toggle, dropdowns, and accessible states.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None
    
    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()
        
        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )
        
        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)
        
        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()
        
        # Navigate to your target URL and wait until the network request is committed
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3001", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # Wait for the main page to reach DOMContentLoaded state (optional for stability)
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
        except async_api.Error:
            pass
        
        # Iterate through all iframes and wait for them to load as well
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                await frame.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
            except async_api.Error:
                pass
        
        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Test dropdown menus appear on hover and contain correct links
        await page.mouse.wheel(0, 200)
        

        # -> Resize viewport to mobile width using a different method, preferably a direct viewport resize or user agent emulation.
        await page.goto('http://localhost:3001/', timeout=10000)
        await asyncio.sleep(3)
        

        await page.mouse.wheel(0, 100)
        

        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click language button to check if hamburger menu or mobile menu is visible
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/header/div/div/div[2]/div/span/button').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # -> Resize viewport to mobile width using browser commands or automation to simulate mobile device.
        await page.mouse.wheel(0, -await page.evaluate('() => window.innerHeight'))
        

        # -> Resize viewport to mobile width using browser automation commands or settings to simulate mobile device and test mobile navigation menu including hamburger toggle and dropdowns.
        await page.goto('http://localhost:3001/', timeout=10000)
        await asyncio.sleep(3)
        

        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click language button to check if hamburger menu or mobile menu is visible
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/header/div/div/div[2]/div/span/button').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        await page.mouse.wheel(0, 100)
        

        # -> Test hamburger menu icon visibility and main navigation links hidden state on mobile viewport, then click hamburger menu to open navigation drawer and test dropdown expand/collapse and keyboard accessibility.
        await page.goto('http://localhost:3001/', timeout=10000)
        await asyncio.sleep(3)
        

        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        try:
            await expect(frame.locator('text=Navigation Menu Loaded Successfully')).to_be_visible(timeout=1000)
        except AssertionError:
            raise AssertionError("Test plan execution failed: Navigation menus including hamburger toggle, dropdowns, and accessible states could not be verified as expected.")
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
    
    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()
            
asyncio.run(run_test())

title: TC003-Public Product Listings and Details Navigation
description: Validate product listings segmented by Bespoke and Modular categories and navigation to detailed product pages.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None
    
    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()
        
        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )
        
        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)
        
        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()
        
        # Navigate to your target URL and wait until the network request is committed
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3001", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # Wait for the main page to reach DOMContentLoaded state (optional for stability)
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
        except async_api.Error:
            pass
        
        # Iterate through all iframes and wait for them to load as well
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                await frame.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
            except async_api.Error:
                pass
        
        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Click on Bespoke category link to view Bespoke products
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click on BESPOKE category link
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/header/div/div/nav/div/div[3]/a').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # -> Click on a Bespoke product to open its details page
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click on 'View Portfolio' button for a Bespoke product to open its details page
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/main/div/section[2]/div/div/div/button').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # -> Click on Modular category link to view Modular products
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click on '모듈러건축 소개' (Modular) category link
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/header/div/div/nav/div/div/a').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # -> Click on a Modular product to open its detail page and verify product details load correctly
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click on Modular product 'S' link
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/header/div/div[2]/div/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/a').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # -> Ensure images lazy load as user scrolls without layout jumps on Modular product detail page
        await page.mouse.wheel(0, 1000)
        

        # -> Click on Modular product 'M' to verify its detail page loads correctly
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click on Modular product 'M' link
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/header/div/div[2]/div/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/a[2]').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        await expect(frame.locator('text=BESPOKE').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=모듈러건축 소개').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=S').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=M').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=L').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=XL').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=What is BESPOKE? (/bespoke#what-is-bespoke)').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=Examples (/bespoke#examples)').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=What is Modular? (/modular#what-is-modular)').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=Modular Types (/modular#modular-types)').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=Prefabrication (/modular#prefabrication)').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=OSC (/modular#osc)').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=Assembly Method (/modular#assembly)').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
    
    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()
            
asyncio.run(run_test())
